title: Just Box It

# Just Box It Mod
The JustBoxIt Mod simply adds paperboard boxes, and a bunch of present boxes, 2 for every dye. 

## Boxes
- Those boxes are a new type of container with 9 inventory slot, and are affected by gravity.
- When a box is empty, it stays open, but once it got something inside, it close itself.
- Can be crafted with 4 Papers and a Cutter.

## Present Boxes
- It behaves just like normal boxes, but has 32 variants.
- Can be crafted with a Box, a Dye and a compatible Ribbon.

## Cutter
- An item that can be used to craft Boxes and Ribbons.
- Can be crafted with 1 Shears and a Copper Ingot.

## Ribbons
- It get used to craft a particular Present Box.
- Can be crafted with a Cutter and the choosen Wool block.
